chapter: A Clash Between the First and the Latest!
act_title: A Clash Between the First and the Latest!

quests.title: A Clash Between the First and the Latest!

dialogue.sit: After a while, you and Paimon arrive at the Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta booth...

dialogue.t: Oh, the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor! Are you back for more of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta?
Ms. Enghiene received orders to return to the Maison Gardiennage, so I'll be playing against you for now!
Hey, Souka! You're back!
Paimon was pretty surprised when we met Haniyyah, but you've taken it to the next level! Your outfit is so... Well, you sure are enthusiastic!
And that's a good thing, because I have a lot of work... I need to stay motivated.
And that's why I'll cut my problems down, one clean axe-swing at a time!

dialogue.sit: How are things at the newspaper?
How are the advertisements coming along?

dialogue.t: Our plan is progressing steadily. Novel events like these attract a lot of attention, and the paper won't miss any promotion opportunities!
We didn't get the most important page, but it's clear that the event's becoming more popular.
That's right. We've seen an increase in ordinary citizens who wanted to give our game a try recently.
Many have been talking about what's the best Fungi team with which to win a round quickly.
I've also heard that people have been looking to play against you two, so they can see how the experts play.

dialogue.sit: We'd like to keep a low profile.
Alas, so many people, and such hurry to lose...

dialogue.t: Unless the two of you play against us, of course. You know our strategies very well already...
Paimon thinks a match between you and us... will be a real test of technique!
Well, you're here now, so why don't we play a friendly round?
Come to think of it, the last time we went head-to-head with you was during the first Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament, where you beat me most soundly.
How nostalgic. After that, Haniyyah and I went through a lot together, and many things changed. I bet it was the same with you.
But your... seasoned courage and fearless aura are still as unwavering and sturdy as crystal.
That alone was enough for us to decide that we'd follow you, back when we were preparing Fungus Mechanicus. I think we made the right choice!
Uh, why are you reminiscing all of a sudden? Is it something that writers do?

dialogue.sit: We can make new memories together.

dialogue.t: Yes! What an incredible line!
Anyway, as one of the designers of the game, I've got an ace up my sleeve!
Are you talking about "that," Souka?
That's right. I'll get started, and then Haniyyah will control powerful opponents against you. It should make for an exciting match!
Let's do this, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!
After all this time, you're going up against Haniyyah again... Ooh, this is so exciting!
But this is a friendly match, so let's just have fun!

quests.description: Souka, an old friend, returns to Lil’ Fungi’s Fun-Tastic Fiesta, and proposes a match between you and Haniyyah…
